decorativeCandidates.definition: Current plan objects with kind IN ('static','whole'); distinct object identities, not shard entries or voxel count.

protectedOrUncertainOriginalKinds.definition: Current nonselected preserve/other kinds, separate from the static+whole candidate denominator.

substrateScope.definition: Ordinary/native source substrate identities are not the decorative candidate population. Nonselected does not mean untouched: native bases may have been transferred without selected_objects.

committedAutomaticLocalOriginals.meaning: This finite journal is a subset of original retentions and overlaps current object-kind groups; never add it to the candidate remainder.

preservationProvenanceFromCachedPrefix.meaning: Protection reasons may overlap and reserve visual cells; this is not an additive unique-owner partition.

method.sql:
SELECT o.kind,o.reason,o.source_status,CASE WHEN s.uuid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS selected,count(*) AS objects
FROM objects o LEFT JOIN selected_objects s ON s.dim=o.dim AND s.uuid=o.uuid
GROUP BY o.kind,o.reason,o.source_status,CASE WHEN s.uuid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
ORDER BY o.kind,o.reason,o.source_status,selected
method.presentation: Reason totals and prefix/delta presentation derived from the one SQL result and cached JSON receipts only; no additional SQL. Prefix groups keep logical SourcePose registry names; new owners report actual raw root registry separately.

limits: Remaining means nonselected current-plan identities; source_status and object reason are classifier metadata, not always the later retention trigger.
Substrate counts include ordinary/native bases and cannot be called unconverted decorative blocks.
Apply-journal retainedOwners=37799 are per-shard table entries with duplicates, not unique owners; they are not used here.
Journal and protected-provenance groups overlap and are not added to the object population.
No world census, source-cache validation, tests, FPS measurement or full coverage rerun was performed.

remainingOriginalOwnersExcludingSubstrat.meaning: Distinct current-plan objects not selected, excluding ordinary/native substrate identities. The classifier reason and source_status are metadata; selected source_status is historical and does not mean currently selected.
